description: A well-presented double room is now available in a clean, comfortable and professionally managed shared house. Situated in a convenient location close to local shops, supermarkets and excellent transport links, this property is ideal for a working professional looking for quality accommodation at an affordable price. The room is bright and spacious, fully furnished and finished in neutral décor, creating a comfortable and welcoming living space. The property benefits from a modern shared kitchen with all essential appliances, clean and well-maintained bathrooms, and high-speed broadband throughout. Communal areas are regularly cleaned to ensure a pleasant environment for all residents.
